papers.title: Surface Modification, Characterization, and Cytotoxicity of Ti-6Al-4V Alloy Enriched by EDM Process
papers.abstract: This study investigates the surface modification of Ti-6Al-4V alloy through the electrical discharge machining (EDM) process to improve its suitability for orthopedic and dental implant applications. The analysis focused on evaluating the morphological, wettability, roughness, hardness, and biocompatibility properties of the modified surfaces. Samples were subjected to different dielectric fluids and polarities during EDM. Subsequently, optical microscopy, roughness measurements, Vickers microhardness, contact angle tests, and in vitro cytotoxicity assays were performed. The results demonstrated that EDM processing led to the formation of distinct layers on the sample surfaces, with surface roughness increasing under negative polarity by up to ~304% in Ra and 305% in Rz. Additionally, wettability measurements indicated that the modified surfaces presented a lower water contact angle, which suggests enhanced hydrophilicity. Moreover, the modified samples showed a significant increase in Vickers microhardness, with the highest value reaching 1520 HV in the recast layer, indicating improvements in the mechanical properties. According to ISO 10993-5, all treated samples were classified as non-cytotoxic, presenting RGR values above 75%, similar to the untreated Ti-6Al-4V alloy. Therefore, it is concluded that surface modification through the EDM process has the potential to enhance the properties and safety of biomedical implants made with this alloy.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V的EDM表面改性，但未关注疲劳性能，也未明确使用增材制造工艺，与层2方向（AM Ti-6Al-4V后处理对疲劳的影响）关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue data, no AM-specific material, and the post-processing (EDM) is not evaluated for mechanical performance beyond hardness.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过EDM表面改性提升Ti-6Al-4V合金在植入物中的性能。
summary_zh.method: 使用不同介电液和极性进行EDM处理，随后进行形貌、硬度及细胞毒性测试。
summary_zh.result: EDM处理使表面粗糙度和硬度显著增加，亲水性改善，且无细胞毒性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微硬度测试和体外细胞毒性实验验证表面性能。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to enhance the surface properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloy for implant applications through electrical discharge machining (EDM) surface modification.
summary_en.method: Samples were subjected to EDM under varying dielectric fluids and polarities, followed by morphological characterization, hardness testing, and in vitro cytotoxicity assays.
summary_en.result: EDM processing increased surface roughness by up to ~304% in Ra and 305% in Rz, raised Vickers microhardness to 1520 HV in the recast layer, improved hydrophilicity, and maintained non-cytotoxicity per ISO 10993-5.
summary_en.validation: The study employed mechanical testing (Vickers microhardness) and in vitro cell assays to validate surface modifications.

papers.title: Residual Stress and Corrosion Performance in L-PBF Ti6Al4V: Unveiling the Optimum Stress Relieving Temperature via Microcapillary Electrochemical Characterisation
papers.abstract: This study aims to determine the optimal low-temperature stress relieving heat treatment that minimizes residual stresses while preserving corrosion resistance in Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) processed Ti6Al4V alloy. Specifically, it investigates the effects of stress relieving at 400 °C, 600 °C, and 800 °C on microstructure, residual stress, and electrochemical performance. Specimens were characterized using X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and electrochemical techniques. A novel microcapillary electrochemical method was employed to precisely assess passive layer stability and corrosion behaviour under simulated oral conditions, including fluoride contamination and tensile loading. Results show that heat treatments up to 600 °C effectively reduce residual stress with minimal impact on corrosion resistance. However, 800 °C treatment leads to a phase transformation from α′ martensite to a dual-phase α + β structure, significantly compromising passive film integrity. The findings establish 600 °C as the optimal stress-relieving temperature for balancing mechanical stability and electrochemical performance in biomedical and aerospace components.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V激光粉末床熔融后不同温度去应力退火对残余应力和腐蚀性能的影响，虽未直接测试疲劳或拉伸性能，但为后处理工艺优化提供了重要参考。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue or tensile testing data; outcome focused on corrosion resistance rather than mechanical performance (e.g., fatigue life, tensile strength).

summary_zh.motivation: 确定最优去应力退火温度，平衡残余应力消除与耐蚀性
summary_zh.method: 对LPBF Ti6Al4V在400、600、800°C进行去应力退火，结合XRD、SEM和微毛细管电化学表征
summary_zh.result: 600°C为最佳温度，有效降低残余应力且耐蚀性基本保持，800°C因相变严重损害钝化膜
summary_zh.validation: XRD测量残余应力、电化学测试评价耐蚀性、SEM观察显微组织

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to identify the optimal stress-relieving temperature that minimizes residual stresses while preserving corrosion resistance in L-PBF Ti6Al4V.
summary_en.method: Stress relieving heat treatments at 400, 600, and 800 °C were performed, followed by characterization via XRD, SEM, and a novel microcapillary electrochemical method under simulated oral conditions.
summary_en.result: 600 °C was found to be the optimal temperature, effectively reducing residual stress with minimal impact on corrosion resistance; 800 °C caused α'→α+β transformation and severely degraded passive film integrity.
summary_en.validation: Residual stress was measured by XRD, corrosion behavior was assessed electrochemically, and microstructure was observed by SEM.
